visual_target: integrated live-action human performers with physically grounded wet battlefield or monastery environments, continuous screen direction, and Japanese-production audio constraints

style_lock.description: photographed human performers, practical armor and cloth, real wet materials, motivated cinematic light, natural skin detail and contact shadows

global_reject_if: male Byleth in a female-Byleth shot

reboard_plan.prerequisite: The rough readability thumbnail must pass before final-looking frames are promoted.

method_references.title: Disney Animation Story
method_references.lesson: thumbnail narrative, emotion, timing, staging, and framing before final layout

method_references.title: Disney Animation Layout
method_references.lesson: stage characters, sets, props, camera, point of view, cut relation, and continuity shot by shot

method_references.title: Academy: How To Storyboard Star Trek
method_references.lesson: make approach, conflict, recovery, and payoff legible as a physical sequence

method_references.title: Star Wars Jedi Videomatics
method_references.lesson: test screen direction, action flow, and edit rhythm before final imagery

method_references.title: ILM Art Department: Concept Art and Storyboarding
method_references.lesson: treat storyboards as an action and logistics blueprint

method_references.title: Jump Manga School Lecture 3
method_references.lesson: use wide views for position and distance, closer views for hands and emotion, and keep each panel instantly readable

allowed: public feature-film and animation production notes
professional storyboard, layout, and videomatic breakdowns
published editorial and screen-staging craft references
excluded: all prior local frames as quality or blocking templates
quality_reference_policy.local_asset_boundary: Local selected assets constrain identity, wardrobe, weapon, and geography only. They are not visual-quality, pose, lens, or blocking references.

external_film_staging_reboard.prerequisite: The external film-staging rough thumbnail must pass before final-looking frames are promoted.
